page.overview:
Who is Meneldil?

Meneldil was the third King of Gondor (his father Anárion and uncle Isildur co-ruled Gondor as the second kings, but his father died before Isildur who was sole ruler for a short time).

Meneldil was born in Númenor a year before its fall. The only son and fourth child of Anárion, he was said to be the last child born in Númenor before its downfall. He had three older siblings, all sisters.

After the War of the Last Alliance in which his father Anárion was slain, Meneldil was groomed by his uncle Isildur for a few years to rule Gondor, since Isildur and his sons intended to go north to rule Arnor. According to , Meneldil was farsighted and well-pleased at the planned departure of Isildur and his sons, hoping that affairs in the north would keep them occupied. Meneldil became the third King of Gondor in TA 2, about 4 years after the death of Anárion, after the death of Isildur in the Disaster of the Gladden Fields. Meneldil was the first King of Gondor who ruled independently from the High Kingdom of the Dúnedain, Arnor.

It is uncertain whether Meneldil was King by right, as young cousin Valandil would have had the better claim as High King of Gondor and Arnor, but no claim by Valandil was ever made. It was in any case unlikely that Meneldil would give up his right to rule to a much younger cousin he had never seen. In any case, the people of Gondor did not resist Meneldil's claim to the throne, and King Valandil and his heirs made no serious attempt to regain control over Gondor until the death of King Ondoher and his heirs. In effect, Meneldil thus severed Gondor from Arnor, but the title of High King remained with the northern line.
